title: RBI Proposes Harmonised Regulatory Framework on Interest Rates on Advances
summary: RBI Proposes Harmonised Regulatory Framework on Interest Rates on Advances

items: RBI published draft guidelines proposing to harmonise and standardise the regulatory framework on **interest rates on advances** across all Regulated Entities (banks, NBFCs, UCBs, AIFIs) to ensure transparent rate resets.

blocks.title: Exam Trap & Statutory Distinction
blocks.content: ⚠️ **Regulatory Compliance Trap:** Ensure exact compliance dates, institutional ceilings, and penalty provisions are verified during recall.
